pluginText.pf.messages: {"never":"texts to a patient carry only the business's name, the date, the time, the place, money lines and a secure link: never the visit type, the reason, the health answers or any result; a clinic text names no acupuncturist; a home visit keeps the acupuncturist's name for the door check","staff":"texts to the owner and staff use the patient's initials, the time, the visit type from the list and a link; never a health detail (that's on the secure page: 'notes added')","healthTexts":"a health question or update texted in is never answered by Rosie: it goes to the acupuncturist on the secure page, and the patient is told who will call","languages":"English and Spanish","minors":"a child's texts go to the parent or guardian"}
pluginText.pf.staff: {"licenses":"each acupuncturist's own license, per state, for the place where the patient is seen","skills":"every acupuncturist: first visits, follow-ups, cupping and acupressure; child's visits only for those trained in them (the example: Iris); herbal consults only with the herbal certificate where the state's form asks (the example: Noah); home visits only for those Sam clears","supervision":"none for a licensed acupuncturist; a student works only under supervision, where the state's rules allow it at all (a switch); none at the example businesses","oks":"the owner OKs same-day visits, a booking after a reaction last time, and anything the acupuncturist flags","standIn":"another licensed acupuncturist may stand in, on a time the patient picks or OKs; the notes go with the booking on the secure side; only the acupuncturist decides what's safe","away":"home visits: the acupuncturists Sam clears, each with a portable table"}
pluginText.pf.rules: {"records":"treatment records kept by the business for as long as the state's rules require; a delete request removes only Rosie's own booking details","copies":"a patient's copy of their records within the time the rules set; Rosie sends only booking and payment records","showLicense":"the license and the title shown where the state asks","minors":"who may consent for a minor, and at what age a minor may consent alone (a switch from the state form)","referral":"a doctor's referral or diagnosis first, only where a plan or the state's rules ask (a switch)","healthData":"a separate yes for health answers on the secure page (Rosie's rule); any state's own health-data law comes from that state's form","packages":"any state's rule for prepaid visits comes from the state's form; unused visits refunded on request (Rosie's rule)","ads":"no claims of cures or results; a license is shown as the business gives it; Rosie doesn't check it; a national board certificate shows only as the business's own word","privacy":"health privacy rules for every message and form"}
pluginText.pf.edges: {"lateArrival":"up to 15 minutes late: still seen, ending on time (a shorter treatment at the same price); later: moved with no fee, as the acupuncturist decides","healthChange":"a health change before the visit (a new medicine, a pregnancy): Rosie never answers; the acupuncturist calls; the visit stays unless the patient moves or cancels it, with no fee","notRight":"after reading the answers, the acupuncturist decides acupuncture isn't right now: calls first, says who to see, then the visit is cancelled with no fee","faint":"feels faint at the visit: needles out, lie flat, water; noted for next time; the next booking waits for the owner's OK","forms":"a form not done by its due date: one reminder, then Sam keeps the visit (filled in on the secure page at the desk or the door before any needles), moves it, or cancels with no fee","standIn":"an acupuncturist out: a stand-in who does that visit, offered first, or new times with no fee; a child's visit stays with Iris","planChange":"the plan check comes back not covered: self-pay with the estimate, or a free cancel","twoBookings":"a patient with a series of follow-ups open: Rosie asks which one before any change","urgent":"no visits sent now; a same-day visit for sudden pain gets the soonest time, once Sam OKs it","weather":"none at the clinic; at home, a storm that stops travel: Sam moves the visit with no fee","children":"a child is never left alone with the acupuncturist: a parent or guardian stays","needlestick":"an acupuncturist's needlestick: the visit stops, Sam is told at once, and another acupuncturist finishes or the patient gets a new time with no fee"}
